readings: q is the counter register itself; it updates on the same clock edge as the count value.
q is a separate output register loaded from the counter; it changes one clock cycle after the count value.
q[9] is the most significant bit and q[0] is the least significant bit.
q[0] is the most significant bit and q[9] is the least significant bit.
Asserting reset forces q to 0 on the next rising clock edge.
Asserting reset only clears the internal counter; q is not reset and may hold its previous value (if q is implemented as a separate register).
q is 0 at power-up even if reset has never been asserted.
q is undefined/unknown until reset is asserted.
